# FindAll PhoneInfoga adapter

Imports github.com/sundowndev/phoneinfoga/v2 v2.11.0,
commit 5f6156f567613a07ea8e3f04b004864582060a57; see go.mod/go.sum.

Emits JSON, bounds and routes HTTPS requests, suppresses upstream logging,
and excludes response bodies/authenticated URLs from errors. No server.
Build through ../../setup-phoneinfoga.bat. Integration documentation:
../../docs/PHONEINFOGA_INTEGRATION.md. Upstream GPL-3.0 licence is retained
beside the installed binary.
